description: Returns the order book of one market: resting `bid` levels (best price first, highest) and `ask` levels (best price first, lowest), each with the price (0 to 1), shares and amount at that level and the cumulative totals from the best price, plus the last trade price/time and 24-hour volume and trade count. Takes a MARKET id (an item of an event's `markets`), not an event id. Use it to judge liquidity and slippage before placing an order; only the best `levels` levels per side are returned, with `*_levels_total` giving the full depth.

id.description: Market id, from the `markets` of get_markets or get_market_details.

levels.description: How many price levels to return per side, 1 to 100. Default 10.

position.description: Which side of the market to view: "long" (default) or "short". Short prices are 1 minus long prices.

name: get_order_book
title: Get order book
